boxes.text: comment Double-click the canvas to place a box and type its name. Enter edits the selected box; Tab places a new connected box below it.
comment Drag from an outlet to an inlet to make a cable. Backspace or Delete removes the selection; arrow keys nudge it. Hold space to pan.
comment Select a box and press h for that box's help patch. Escape closes it.
comment Cmd+Enter applies the patch and replaces whatever is running. Z undoes.
comment S saves, O opens, N clears the canvas, Shift+N makes a new abstraction, P reveals the patches folder.
comment Boxes above the border run once, on the laptop. Boxes below it run on every phone. Routers on the border carry events and values across.
